Sessions.title: Your sessions
Sessions.intro: Choose session logs from your project's .claude-logs folder to see how you work with your agent, measured without any AI model.
Sessions.privacy: Your files are read in this browser tab only. Nothing is uploaded or saved, and reloading the page clears them.
